full_query: Will the antibiotics prevent the lyme disease from progressing?
sentences: Antibiotics are effective in preventing the progression of Lyme disease if administered early in the course of the infection
Early treatment typically involves oral antibiotics such as doxycycline, amoxicillin, or cefuroxime axetil
For early localized or early disseminated Lyme disease, a 10- to 21-day course of antibiotics is generally recommended
If Lyme disease is treated promptly, most patients recover completely without long-term complications
However, if the disease is not treated in its early stages, it can progress to more severe forms, including Lyme arthritis, neurological Lyme disease, and Lyme carditis
In such cases, longer courses of antibiotics or intravenous antibiotics may be required
